describe: Distance and compass direction between two places on the globe, for guess-the-place games without a map tap (guess a country by name, then see how far and which way the answer is). Points are vec(lon, lat) in degrees, usually from the `geo` section's `geo_target()` list. `geo_km(a, b)` is the great-circle distance in whole km; `geo_dir(a, b)` is the 8-point compass direction from a to b ('N', 'NE', 'E', 'SE', 'S', 'SW', 'W', 'NW', or '' when they are the same place); `geo_closeness(a, b)` is 0 to 100 (100 = the same place, 0 = the other side of the world). Only arithmetic, sin, cos and sqrt, so replays match. Draws nothing and has no state.

_dlon.body: if b.x - a.x > 180.0 then b.x - a.x - 360.0 else if b.x - a.x < -180.0 then b.x - a.x + 360.0 else b.x - a.x

_dir.body: if abs(dx) < 0.01 and abs(dy) < 0.01 then '' else if abs(dy) > 2.414 * abs(dx) then (if dy > 0.0 then 'N' else 'S') else if abs(dx) > 2.414 * abs(dy) then (if dx > 0.0 then 'E' else 'W') else (if dy > 0.0 then 'N' else 'S') + (if dx > 0.0 then 'E' else 'W')
